stations.instrument: Responsa ad proposita dubia, coetus plenarius 19 Ianuarii 1988 (Pastor bonus art. 154)

interpretation.answer: Negative to the first part; affirmative to the second. Not only expulsion.
interpretation.basis: Read in the Holy See's Latin collection Interpretationes Authenticae, sha256 1e7a0aaa..., at the block headed by this canon; the Dicastery for Legislative Texts serves the same Latin on its own page for this canon and the two were compared and found identical.
interpretation.question: Whether the abortion of c. 1398 is to be understood only of the expulsion of an immature fetus, or also of its killing in whatever way and at whatever time procured from the moment of conception.
